title: The Swift Performance Lite plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the '<attacker-chosen…
description: The Swift Performance Lite plugin for WordPress contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in all versions up to and including 2.3.7.5. This vulnerability arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping of a user-controllable parameter name. An unauthenticated attacker can exploit this flaw to inject arbitrary scripts that execute when a user accesses the affected page. Exploitation requires that an administrator has configured at least one Cacheable AJAX Action via the plugin's AJAX Cache feature, which attackers can detect by probing for a specific response header.
